business_summary: Sintokogio,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells foundry, surface treatment, casting, environmental, conveying, special machinery, and other equipment in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in electronic core materials and ceramics businesses. It also offers green sand and v-process molding, chemically bonded sand, and aluminium casting products; dust collection and fire prevention system, exhaust gas and water treatment products; powder treatment products and technologies; and force sensors. In addition, it provides flooring and electric cylinders, as well as image processing measuring machines and calibration of measuring instruments and machines. Further, it provides shot and air blasting machines, shot peening machines, barrel and precision brush polishing equipment, high-precision micro-machining equipment, surface evaluation equipment, surface treatment parts, abrasives, polishing, materials, etc.; mold molding and V process equipment, core molding and casting sand treatment equipment, and automatic pouring and sand coating equipment; casting equipment and parts, powder and granular processing equipment, wear-resistant castings, etc; dust collectors, deodorizers, wastewater treatment equipment, VOC gas purification equipment, and environmental business components; lifting devices, step-climbing machines; and organic EL panel manufacturing equipment and automated lines. Additionally, it provides dispersizers, battery raw material supply equipment, 3D equipment, 3D printers, ceramic products, molding equipment, automotive door assembly equipment, metal magnetic powders, sterile environment provision equipment; and special machinery business parts, nursing care and welfare products, etc. The company was formerly known as Kubota Seisakusho, Ltd. and changed its name to Sintokogio,Ltd. in February 1960. Sintokogio,Ltd. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Sintokogio,Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본, 중국, 아시아, 미국, 유럽 및 국제적으로 주조, 표면 처리, 주조, 환경, 운반, 특수 기계 및 기타 장비를 제조 및 판매하고 있습니다. 전자 핵심소재 및 세라믹 사업을 영위하고 있는 회사입니다. 또한 생사 및 V-프로세스 성형, 화학적으로 결합된 모래 및 알루미늄 주조 제품도 제공합니다. 집진 및 화재 예방 시스템, 배기가스 및 수처리 제품; 분말 처리 제품 및 기술; 그리고 힘 센서. 또한 바닥재, 전기실린더, 영상처리 측정기, 측정기기 및 기계의 교정도 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 쇼트 및 에어 블라스팅 기계, 쇼트 피닝 기계, 배럴 및 정밀 브러시 연마 장비, 고정밀 미세 가공 장비, 표면 평가 장비, 표면 처리 부품, 연마재, 연마, 재료 등을 제공합니다. 금형 성형 및 V 공정 장비, 코어 성형 및 주조 모래 처리 장비, 자동 주입 및 모래 코팅 장비; 주조 장비 및 부품, 분말 및 입상 가공 장비
